facts.text: The artistic biotope consists of four spheres: the domestic domain, the peer domain, the civil domain, and the market domain.
The domestic domain is about the space, activities, and materials an artist needs to be creative.
The domestic domain relates to Business Model Canvas elements including Key Activities, Value proposition, Key Resources, and Costs.
The peer domain relates to colleagues and other partners an artist needs to improve the quality of their work.
The peer domain relates to Business Model Canvas elements including Key Partners and one of the customer segments.
The civil domain is about podiums and publications an artist needs to make impact.
The civil domain relates to Business Model Canvas elements including Customer segments, Value proposition, Channels, and Partners.
The market domain is about commissioners, funds, and other ways to earn income as an artist.
The market domain relates to Business Model Canvas elements including Customer segments and Revenue streams.
Customer relationships are about getting, keeping, and growing customer relationships.
The user wants customer relationships related to relationships artists need with peers, an audience, podiums and publications, and commissioners and funds/subsidiaries.
The user asks to design typical relationship types per category and give examples.
